high_level_description: The image depicts a framed artwork hanging on a wall. The artwork appears to be an icon or religious painting, featuring a figure of the Virgin Mary holding the infant Jesus. The Virgin Mary is depicted with long dark hair, wearing a dark robe with a red garment underneath. The infant Jesus is nude and is cradled tenderly by the Virgin Mary. The painting has a golden halo around the Virgin Mary's head, which is a common symbol in Christian art representing divinity.
